Dictionary source files in src/main/dictionaries/ are generated from these upstream LibreOffice dictionary files:

- English: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/master/en/en_US.dic
  Affix rules: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/master/en/en_US.aff
- Indonesian: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/master/id/id_ID.dic
  Affix rules: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/master/id/id_ID.aff

Generation rules:
- run ./gradlew :KeyBoardApp:updateDictionaries from the repository root
- run ./gradlew :KeyBoardApp:compileDictionaryAsset from the repository root to regenerate the packaged binary asset
- skip the first line because it is the Hunspell entry count
- parse Hunspell .dic and .aff files offline during generation
- expand matching prefix and suffix rules, including continuation classes used by the upstream dictionaries
- keep lowercase single-word entries that match ^[a-z][a-z'-]*$
- special-case the English pronoun "I" to keep it as "i"
- sort and deduplicate the final word list before binary compilation

The APK ships build/generated/dictionary-assets/dictionary.bin instead of the raw text sources.

Upstream affix, license, and README files are copied into this directory.
